observations: Black Kinect camera with a circular lens on the top and a long sensor strip.
A USB cable is visible, coiled and secured with a green rubber band.
The device is shown in a retail or shop environment, resting on a branded 'McSteve' bag.
The Xbox logo is visible on the bottom right of the sensor strip in photo 0 and 2.
The sensor strip has a matte finish, contrasting with the glossy top lens.
No power adapter or HDMI cable is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The device appears clean in photos, but the sensor strip shows significant surface scratches and wear.
The Xbox logo is visible on the sensor strip in photo 0 and 2.
The sensor strip is designed for motion tracking.
The device is a standard Kinect camera.
The device is shown without a power adapter or HDMI cable, which are required for a Kinect to function.

risks.proof: A video showing the camera scanning a pattern or a close-up of the lens glass.

risks.risk: The device may not power on or may have a faulty sensor.
risks.proof: A video of the camera powered on and successfully syncing with an Xbox One console.

risks.risk: The included power adapter and HDMI cable may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the power adapter and the HDMI cable.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the camera powered on and scanning the sensor.
Photo of the power adapter and HDMI cable.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
